REVERSA vám pomôže pochopiť, čo robí pro: REVERSA helps you understand what a program does, even without its source code. Here is how, in 5 steps.
Tlačidlom „Otvoriť súbor“ vyberte progra: Use the “Open file” button to choose a program (ELF from Linux, PE/.exe from Windows, or raw data). If you have nothing to open, use the sample binary: a small CTF task with a password. Analysis runs in the background and can be cancelled.
Program sa skladá z funkcií. Hlavná funk: A program is made of functions. The main function is marked with a star. Click a function to open it; use the filter above the list to find one quickly.
Listing ukazuje inštrukcie procesora, Ps: The listing shows the processor instructions, the pseudocode rewrites them as readable C-like code, and the graphs show the structure of a function and its calls. Switch with the tabs or keys 1 to 4. Blue names are clickable.
Tu vidíte, kto funkciu alebo reťazec pou: Here you see who uses a function or string (cross-references). You can rename a function (N), add a comment (;) or a bookmark (B). Everything can be undone (Ctrl+Z) and saved to a project (Ctrl+S).

Open file…  ·  Sample binary  ·  Getting started guide

REVERSA analyses statically: the program under study is never run.
Listing ukazuje inštrukcie procesora za: The listing shows the processor instructions in order. Blue names are clickable: click to jump to the target of a jump or call.
Pseudokód je čitateľný prepis funkcie do: Pseudocode is a readable rewrite of the function in a C-like language. It is provisional: when in doubt, check the listing. Click a variable to select it, press N to rename it.
Graf toku riadenia (CFG) ukazuje bloky f: The control flow graph (CFG) shows the blocks of a function and the jumps between them. Green = condition true, red = false, orange frame = loop. Zoom with the mouse wheel.
Tento graf ukazuje, ktoré funkcie volajú: This graph shows which functions call which. Double-click opens a function. Zoom with the mouse wheel, drag to pan.
Reťazce sú texty nájdené v súbore. Stĺpe: Strings are texts found in the file. The References column shows how many places in the code use them; click to find them.
Importy sú funkcie, ktoré program použív: Imports are functions the program uses from other libraries (e.g. printf, strcmp). They often reveal what the program does.
Exporty sú funkcie a dáta, ktoré súbor p: Exports are functions and data the file offers to other programs (typical for libraries).
Sekcie sú časti súboru: kód (.text), dát: Sections are parts of the file: code (.text), data (.data, .rodata) and others. Click one to see its bytes in a hex dump (first 64 KiB). Permissions: r = read, w = write, x = execute.
Bookmarks and comments you added. Add them in the Details panel or with the keys B and ;.
Výsledky posledného hľadania. Dvojklikom: Results of the last search. Double-click to jump to the place in the code.
Vlastné pohľady pridané pluginmi alebo s: Custom views added by plugins or scripts: program.add_view("Name", function).
